_doc: Your own surfaces for scripts/robotino.sh --surface-file examples/my_surfaces.json --surfaces linoleum_soft,rubber_tiles,gravel_like (or scripts/drive.sh --surface-file ...). 'base': take every parameter of an existing surface and change the listed ones. Meaning of the parameters: docs/en/SURFACES.md.

linoleum_soft._doc: soft linoleum: like the table, but the roller rubber grips PVC better (mu 0.8) and the covering is a little softer (roller losses x2)

rubber_tiles._doc: soft 20 mm rubber tiles (gym floor): friction and losses as the gray rubber mat + an elastic layer

gravel_like._doc: rough example: dense sand with a large spread of properties (cv_soil 0.4) and a 10 cm heterogeneity scale
